title: Anvesa Pattern Schema (v1)
description: One declarative structural pattern, compiled to WQL. A project's live in .anvesa/patterns/<name>.json, yours in ~/.anvesa/patterns/<name>.json; the file is named after the pattern. Check one with: anvesa pattern check <name>.

name.description: The pattern's name, and its file's name without .json: lowercase letters, digits and -.

description.description: What the pattern finds, shown by pattern list.

filters.description: Further conditions on the target's attributes, all of which must hold.

params.description: Values given at run time (pattern run <name> key=value), used as "$key" in a target name field or a filter value.

corpus.description: Only files in this named corpus are searched.

limit.description: How many hits a run returns unless the caller says otherwise.

kind.description: callable is a function or a method. custom needs customTag.

nameRegex.description: A regular expression the name matches.

customTag.description: The node tag to find, for kind custom.

scope.description: Where the target must be. withinName and directChild apply only with within.

within.description: The tag of the enclosing node, such as class.

directChild.description: The target is a direct child of the enclosing node, not any descendant.

attr.description: The attribute to test, such as visibility or async.

value.description: The value to compare with, or "$param". Ignored for exists.

default.description: The value when a run gives none.

required.description: A run without a value (and with no default) is an error.
